# Golden provenance

Every golden or vector under `tests/goldens/` and `tests/vectors/` lists its generator, the tool versions it depends on, and a volatility grade (1 = deterministic everywhere; 5 = expected to drift). Regeneration is `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest <test> -k <name>` followed by a commit whose message names the tool version that moved it.

| File | Generator | Tool versions | Volatility | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tests/vectors/curve60_seed1.json` | `/opt/homebrew/bin/gp -q -f -s 64M tests/vectors/gen60.gp` (smoke test `test_curve60_vector_matches_live_gp`) | PARI/GP 2.17.4, libpari 2.17.2 (cypari2 2.2.4 reproduces it in-process) | 3 | Deterministic under the pinned call sequence; depends on libpari's PRNG, so a libpari bump may legitimately move it. `tries` must stay 45 while the sequence is the one `toy_curve` pins for bits > 50. |
| `tests/vectors/toy_curve_rows.json` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/integration/test_toy_curve.py -k rows` (`cairn.skills.toy_curve.run(bits, seed)` for seeds 1–3 at 30/40/50/60 bits under the pinned call sequence; `test_gp_cypari2_rows_agree_plumbing_one_library_twice` re-derives every row in gp and `test_rows_reproduce_the_grounding_brief_tries` pins the tries) | cypari2 2.2.4 / libpari 2.17.2 (gp 2.17.4 agrees row for row: one library twice) | 3 | Deterministic under the pinned call sequence (`setrand`; `randomprime`; `random(p)` pairs, singular pairs skipped and not counted; `ellcard` through 50 bits, `ellsea(E,1)` plus the `ellcard` confirm above; `P = random(E)` drawn after the confirm) and libpari's PRNG: a libpari bump or any call-order change legitimately moves the rows, a cypari2 bump without a libpari change must not. The same class as `curve60_seed1.json`; the 60-bit seed-1 row equals it field for field. Regeneration lands only in an attributed commit that names the libpari version and why the rows moved. |
| `tests/vectors/canon_kat.json` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_canon.py -k kat` (builds the fixed synthetic inputs in `tests/unit/test_canon.py::build_vectors` and hashes them through `cairn.kat.compute`) | blake3 1.0.9 (pure bytes, no PARI) | 1 | Deterministic and platform-independent; a regenerated KAT lands only in an attributed commit naming the encoding change, since it is the canonicalizer gate self-test (`cairn kat canon`). Per-vector canonical bytes below. |
| `tests/vectors/claims_kat.json` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_claims_kat.py -k kat_matches` (one object per claims kind from `tests/factories.py` with factory seed 20260821 and `created_at` held at `2026-08-21T00:00:00.000000+00:00`, hashed through `cairn.claims`) | blake3 1.0.9 (pure bytes, no PARI) | 1 | Deterministic and platform-independent; one hash + canonical bytes per claims object kind (hypothesis object, claim statement, evidence node, repro record, review verdict, gate run, ticket); a regenerated KAT lands only in an attributed commit naming the schema change (`tests/unit/test_claims_kat.py::test_claims_kat_guard_rejects_drift` is the drift guard). |

| `tests/goldens/capabilities.golden` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/unit/test_cli_contract.py -k golden` (output of `cairn capabilities --json` with `version`/`python` scrubbed to `[VERSION]`/`[PYTHON]`) | none (pure CLI registry) | 1 | The agent-facing contract; a change here is a contract change and lands only with an attributed commit. |
| `tests/goldens/help_top.golden`, `tests/goldens/help_<command>.golden` | same command, `-k help` | argparse of the pinned CPython | 2 | `--help` text of the top level and of every registered subcommand; argparse wording can move with a CPython bump. |

| `tests/goldens/toy_curve_selftest_transcript.golden` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/integration/test_toy_curve_selftest.py -k golden` (the canonical transcript of `cairn.selftest.run_once`, hex, one line per corpus case and per arm) | PARI 2.17.4, cypari2 2.2.4, gp binary, blake3 1.0.9 | 3 | Six lines: four corpus cases then the postcondition and verifier arms. Byte-equal across the double run, since no timestamp enters the transcript and the seed, hashers and clock are pinned. The grade is 3 rather than 2 because the seeded arm draws from `H(implementation_revision || 'selftest-seed')`, so the arm's curve and therefore this file move whenever any path in `toy_curve.IDENTITY_SOURCES` changes: `src/cairn/pari.py`, `src/cairn/skills/toy_curve.py`, `src/cairn/skills/toy_curve_corpus.json`. That coupling is the point. A revision that moves the transcript needs a fresh certificate, so the regeneration and the re-mint land in one attributed commit naming the source that moved. The bundle hash is deliberately absent, which keeps the file stable across bundle rebuilds. |
| `tests/goldens/toy_curve_floor.golden` | same command, `-k golden` | PARI 2.17.4, cypari2 2.2.4, gp binary | 2 | `{pass: 4, floor: 4, arms: {postcondition: pass, verifier: {ok: 20, fail: 20}}}`. Counts only, so it is independent of the implementation revision. Only an attributed change may raise the floor, which is PLAN section 2's rule; `pass_floor` itself lives in `src/cairn/skills/toy_curve_corpus.json`. |
| `tests/goldens/toy_curve_certificate.golden` | same command, `-k certificate_golden` | PARI 2.17.4, cypari2 2.2.4, gp binary, libpari, host OS | 4 | Holds the certificate together with the identity bundle hash, env manifest hash, transcript hash and implementation revision it was minted under. It folds in `env_manifest_hash`, which depends on libpari, the gp binary digest and the OS, so the recorded value is valid for the recorded platform only. The test recomputes the certificate from the golden transcript hash plus the live identity and env hashes and asserts the live certificate equals that recomputation; it asserts equality with the recorded certificate only when the live identity and env hashes both match the recorded pair. |
| `tests/goldens/gate_bundle_hash.golden` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/integration/test_gate_bundle.py -k bundle_hash_golden` (`cairn.bundle.build` over `bundle/*.json` plus `src/cairn/gp/verify.gp`, twice under tmp_path) | none (BLAKE3 over canonical bytes; no PARI, no sqlite content in the hash) | 2 | Hashed sources: `bundle/allow_lists.json`, `bundle/auditor.json`, `bundle/gate_plan.json`, `bundle/lean.json`, `bundle/role_templates.json`, `bundle/tiers.json`, `bundle/verifier.json`, `bundle/waivable_checks.json`, `src/cairn/gp/verify.gp`. Deterministic and platform-independent: the bundle holds strings, ints, bools, nulls and bytes only, `backend_path` among them as a string. It moves only when a bundle source changes, which is an operator act, so a regenerated golden lands only with `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1` in an attributed commit naming the source that moved. The deploy-time copy of this rule is the pin. |
| `tests/goldens/m0_run_transcript.golden` | `UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 uv run pytest tests/e2e/test_m0_slice.py -k transcript` (the ordered `cairn` log records of `cairn m0-run --bits 40 --seed 1` after the operator sequence, scrubbed by `scrub()` in `tests/conftest.py`) | PARI/GP 2.17.4, libpari 2.17.2, cypari2 2.2.4, blake3 1.0.9 | 2 | Shape-deterministic: one line per gate-plan step with its expected and observed verdict, one per M0 slice step, one per verifier arm with its reason codes, and one for the submitter-named refusal carrying `spawned=False`. Every 64-hex digest scrubs to `[HASH]`, every 32-hex id to `[ID]`, `wall_ms` to `[MS]`, tmp paths to `[PATH]`, and the bundle digest to `[BUNDLE]`, so it holds across machines and runs. It moves when a step is added or removed, when a verdict or reason vocabulary changes, or when the gate bundle's plan changes; it does not move with timings, hashes or paths. A regeneration lands only in an attributed commit naming which step or vocabulary moved. |
